name: RIACO Frequently Bought Together for WooCommerce
author: robertoiacono

sections.description:
RIACO Frequently Bought Together for WooCommerce adds a “Frequently Bought Together” box to WooCommerce product pages, helping store owners increase average order value by suggesting related or complementary products.

What Problem Does It Solve?

Online shoppers often miss out on relevant add-ons or complementary products simply because they’re not aware of them.

As a result, store owners lose potential upsell opportunities.

RIACO Frequently Bought Together addresses this by automatically displaying curated product bundles right on the product page, mimicking the successful strategy used by major eCommerce platforms like Amazon.

Features

Customizable Product Bundles
Display a fully customizable “Frequently Bought Together” box to showcase related products that naturally go with the current item.

Boost Average Order Value
Encourage customers to purchase more by suggesting product combinations that make sense, like a camera with a memory card, or a dress with matching accessories.

Flexible Discount Options
Offer a fixed amount discount or a percentage-based discount on the bundled items to incentivize purchases.
If a customer removes a product from the bundle, the discount will automatically adjust or be removed entirely, ensuring accurate pricing.

Seamless WooCommerce Integration
Built specifically for WooCommerce, the plugin fits naturally into your existing store layout and works with most themes and product types.

Easy Configuration
Set up recommended product combinations directly from the product edit screen in your WordPress dashboard. No coding required.

Improved User Experience
Help customers discover useful product combinations without having to search manually, leading to a smoother shopping experience and more conversions.

Whether you run a fashion store, electronics shop, or sell digital downloads, RIACO Frequently Bought Together for WooCommerce is the smart way to increase your revenue and deliver greater value to your customers, all with minimal setup.

Turn browsers into buyers with smarter upsells.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/frequently-bought-together-woo directory, or install the plugin directly through the WordPress plugin repository.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Ensure WooCommerce is installed and active.
  4. Configure the settings in Settings → Frequently Bought Together.
  5. Add frequently bought together products for each single product in Edit Product → Frequently Bought Together tab.
  6. (Optional) Activate the discount feature and set a discount value based on Fixed or Percentage type.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require WooCommerce?

Yes, WooCommerce must be installed and activated for this plugin to work.

Is this plugin compatible with HPOS (High-Performance Order Storage)?

Yes, the plugin is fully compatible with HPOS.

Can I customize the Frequently Bought Together box?

Yes, the plugin provides basic customization options in WooCommerce settings or you can style as you want using css.
